text: Let us explore day and night! We can practice daytime activities and cozy bedtime routines. Every family has its own routines.
It is morning! Find the curtains so we can open them and let in daylight.
Let's try again. It is morning! Find the curtains so we can open them and let in daylight.
You opened the curtains! Daylight can help us see our room.
It is breakfast time! Find the apple we can eat with our morning meal.
Let's try again. It is breakfast time! Find the apple we can eat with our morning meal.
You found the apple! Families enjoy many different foods at breakfast.
We are going for a daytime walk with a grown-up. Find the shoes for our feet.
Let's try again. We are going for a daytime walk with a grown-up. Find the shoes for our feet.
Shoes on! We can explore outside together during the day.
It is bedtime. Find the toothbrush so a grown-up can help us brush our teeth.
Let's try again. It is bedtime. Find the toothbrush so a grown-up can help us brush our teeth.
That is the toothbrush! We brush in the morning and before bed, with help from a grown-up.
We are getting ready for bed. Find the soft washcloth to help wash our face.
Let's try again. We are getting ready for bed. Find the soft washcloth to help wash our face.
A soft washcloth can help us get clean. We can wash our face at other times, too!
It is a quiet evening. Find a book to share with a grown-up before bed.
Let's try again. It is a quiet evening. Find a book to share with a grown-up before bed.
A story can help us settle down. We can enjoy books during the day, too!
Let us pack for a daytime trip! Move the water bottle, hat, and shoes into the backpack.
Let's try again. Let us pack for a daytime trip! Move the water bottle, hat, and shoes into the backpack.
Our bag is ready! A grown-up can help us choose what we need outside.
It is lunchtime! Move the plate, cup, and spoon onto the table.
Let's try again. It is lunchtime! Move the plate, cup, and spoon onto the table.
The table is ready for lunch. We helped get ready for a daytime meal!
Let us make art this afternoon! Move the crayons, paper, and paintbrush into the art tray.
Let's try again. Let us make art this afternoon! Move the crayons, paper, and paintbrush into the art tray.
Our art supplies are ready! We can make colorful pictures together.
Playtime is finished for the evening. Move the ball, teddy bear, and block into the toy box.
Let's try again. Playtime is finished for the evening. Move the ball, teddy bear, and block into the toy box.
The toys are put away! Tidying helps us get ready for a quieter evening.
Let us choose bedtime clothes! Move the pajama top, pajama pants, and socks into the basket.
Let's try again. Let us choose bedtime clothes! Move the pajama top, pajama pants, and socks into the basket.
Our bedtime clothes are ready! Your family can choose what feels comfortable for sleep.
Let us make our pretend bed cozy! Move the pillow, blanket, and teddy bear onto the bed.
Let's try again. Let us make our pretend bed cozy! Move the pillow, blanket, and teddy bear onto the bed.
Our pretend bed is ready. Your grown-up helps you make your own sleeping space cozy.
Before our daytime meal, we wash our hands with a grown-up. First, choose the water to wet our hands.
Next, choose the soap. Pretend to rub our hands together with soap.
Now choose the towel. We rinse off the soap with water, then dry our hands.
Let's try again. Before our daytime meal, we wash our hands with a grown-up. First, choose the water to wet our hands.

Let's try again. Now choose the towel. We rinse off the soap with water, then dry our hands.
We practiced wetting, washing, rinsing, and drying our hands before a meal!
It is daytime plant care! First, choose our plant and look at its soil with a grown-up.
Our pretend plant needs water. Choose the watering can to give it a little drink.
Now choose the sunny window. Our plant can get the light it needs there.

We are going outside on a sunny day. First, choose our sun hat.
Next, choose the grown-up. We stay together when we go outside.
Now choose the tree. We are ready to enjoy a little nature walk together!

Next, choose the soap. Our grown-up helps us wash and rinse.
Now choose the towel. Our grown-up helps us dry off.

Now choose the heart. Relax your hands and enjoy a quiet moment.
